name: Reflection
description: Agents log friction as it happens; on days with new friction, Reflection looks into it, reports, and asks you before fixing anything.
author: mobius-os

tools.name: log_friction
tools.description: Record friction you just hit: anything that made this work harder than it should have been. One short, self-contained description of what happened and what it cost. Returns immediately; carry on with the task.

friction.description: What happened and what it cost, in one short text.
